documents.thisComparisonHasExpiredOpenIt.en: This comparison has expired. Open it again from AlwayGit.
documents.thisComparisonHasExpiredOpenIt.zh-CN: 此比较已过期，请从 AlwayGit 重新打开。

documents.alwayGitBinaryFileTextComparis.en: [AlwayGit: binary file. Text comparison is unavailable.]
documents.alwayGitBinaryFileTextComparis.zh-CN: [AlwayGit：二进制文件，无法进行文本比较。]

documents.workingFileMissing.en: The file {{path}} does not exist in the current working tree. It may have been deleted or may not be checked out.
documents.workingFileMissing.zh-CN: 当前工作区中不存在文件 {{path}}，可能已删除或尚未检出。
documents.workingFileMissing.context: src/editor/documents.ts / openFile / missing working tree path

documents.thisPathIsADirectoryOrSubmodul.en: This path is a directory or submodule, not a text file.
documents.thisPathIsADirectoryOrSubmodul.zh-CN: 此路径是目录或子模块，不是文本文件。

documents.thisFileIsNotPartOfTheSavedSta.en: This file is not part of the saved Stash files.
documents.thisFileIsNotPartOfTheSavedSta.zh-CN: 此文件不在已保存的 Stash 文件中。

documents.thisFileIsNotPartOfTheSelected.en: This file is not part of the selected comparison.
documents.thisFileIsNotPartOfTheSelected.zh-CN: 此文件不属于所选比较。

documents.theFileStatusChangedRefreshAnd.en: The file status changed. Refresh and open its comparison again.
documents.theFileStatusChangedRefreshAnd.zh-CN: 文件状态已变化，请刷新后重新打开比较。

documents.thisFileHasNoStagedChangesRefr.en: This file has no Staged Changes. Refresh its comparison.
documents.thisFileHasNoStagedChangesRefr.zh-CN: 此文件没有已暂存的更改，请刷新其比较。

documents.thisFileNoLongerHasAConflictRe.en: This file no longer has a conflict. Refresh its comparison.
documents.thisFileNoLongerHasAConflictRe.zh-CN: 此文件已不存在冲突，请刷新其比较。

documents.oursTheirsEditWorkingFileToRes.en: {{value}} · Ours ↔ Theirs (edit working file to resolve)
documents.oursTheirsEditWorkingFileToRes.zh-CN: {{value}} · 我方 ↔ 对方（编辑工作文件以解决冲突）

documents.thisFileHasNoUnstagedChangesRe.en: This file has no Unstaged Changes. Refresh its comparison.
documents.thisFileHasNoUnstagedChangesRe.zh-CN: 此文件没有未暂存的更改，请刷新其比较。

documents.imagesAndBinaryFilesCanOnlyBeV.en: Images and binary files can only be viewed in the AlwayGit Diff preview.
documents.imagesAndBinaryFilesCanOnlyBeV.zh-CN: 图片和二进制文件只能在 AlwayGit Diff 预览中查看。

documents.textComparisonResourceLimit.en: The complete text comparison reached a resource limit (32 MiB per side; 128 MiB for text and index caches). No partial comparison is displayed.
documents.textComparisonResourceLimit.zh-CN: 完整文本比较达到资源保护上限（每侧文本 32 MiB，文本与索引缓存合计 128 MiB），未显示不完整的比较结果。

documents.invalidDiffIndex.en: Git returned an inconsistent text comparison. Refresh and try again.
documents.invalidDiffIndex.zh-CN: Git 返回的文本比较位置不一致，请刷新后重试。

documents.unsafeDiffCleanup.en: The temporary comparison directory could not be safely removed.
documents.unsafeDiffCleanup.zh-CN: 临时比较目录无法安全清理。
